title: Where the Diagram Opens
statement: A map, a manual heading, and a clockwork diagram insist on a route. The fish crosses their measured language, while fungal lace extends beyond it: the instruction remains visible, but its ending becomes a place for interpretation.

actions.title: Where the Diagram Opens
actions.statement: A map, a manual heading, and a clockwork diagram insist on a route. The fish crosses their measured language, while fungal lace extends beyond it: the instruction remains visible, but its ending becomes a place for interpretation.

notes.note: The existing work has a clear central collision between theory and departure. I will sharpen the transition by adding a vivid, radial anemone as an unruly counter-instruction at lower right, and a small jewel beetle as a mobile accent breaking away from the title field.

The collage now reads clearly, but it benefits from one explicit visual threshold. I will add a narrow floral-textile rule behind the existing specimens: a patterned seam that the fish has already crossed and the fungal/anemone forms visibly reinterpret below it.

The image is cohesive, with the fish visibly crossing the patterned threshold. I will add a restrained bridge fragment low in the field, behind the organic cutouts, to make the seam between prescribed structure and personal passage more legible without crowding the title or central fish.

The composition is finished: its centered fish crosses a literal patterned threshold between the instruction-like title, map, and gear above and the fungal, anemone, and bridge passages below. The contrast of clean rectangular directives and irregular organic cutouts clearly holds the intended boundary between following and interpreting.
